description: US · Other · tradeunionco.com tuc-dxb.com Trade Union Co. is a family-owned automotive spare parts wholesaler and retailer founded in 1960 in Beirut, Lebanon, with over 65 years of experience serving customers across the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas. The group operates through its Beirut headquarters and The Trade Union International LLC in Dubai, a 5000 square meter global re-export hub
